APIs.io Engineering Platform Get all elements and folders

params.name: since
params.description: Return only results created since the given time, in [ISO 8601](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6) format. This value cannot be later than the `until` value.

params.name: until
params.description: Return only results created until this given time, in [ISO 8601](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6) format. This value cannot be earlier than the `since` value.

params.name: addedBy
params.description: Return only elements published by the given user ID.

params.name: name
params.description: Return only elements whose name includes the given value. Matching is not case-sensitive.

params.name: summary
params.description: Return only elements whose summary includes the given value. Matching is not case-sensitive.

params.name: description
params.description: Return only elements whose description includes the given value. Matching is not case-sensitive.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort the results by the given value. If you use this query parameter, you must also use the `direction` parameter.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort in ascending (`asc`) or descending (`desc`) order. Matching is not case-sensitive. If you use this query parameter, you must also use the `sort` parameter.

params.name: createdBy
params.description: Return only results created by the given user ID.

params.name: offset
params.description: The zero-based offset of the first item to return.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of elements to return. If the value exceeds the maximum value of `1000`, then the system uses the `1000` value.

params.name: parentFolderId
params.description: Return the folders and elements in a specific folder. If this value is `0`, then the endpoint only returns the root folder's elements.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by the element type.

items.docs:
Gets information about the folders and their elements added to your [Private API Network](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/adding-private-network/).

**Note:**

The `limit` and `offset` parameters are separately applied to elements and folders. For example, if you query a `limit` value of `10` and an `offset` value `0`, the endpoint returns 10 elements and 10 folders for a total of 20 items. info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Add an element or folder

items.docs:
Publishes a element or creates a folder in your [Private API Network](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/adding-private-network/). An element is a Postman API, collection, or workspace.

**Note:**

You can only pass one element object type per call. For example, you cannot pass both `api` and `collection` in a single request.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Update an element or folder

params.name: elementId
params.description: The element's ID or UUID. For Postman Collections you must pass the collection's UID (`userId`-`collectionId`) value.

params.name: elementType
params.description: The element type.

Updates an element or folder in your [Private API Network](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/adding-private-network/).

**Note:**

You can only pass one element object type per call. For example, you cannot pass both `api` and `collection` in a single request.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Remove an element or folder

params.name: elementId
params.description: The element's ID or UUID. For Postman Collections you must pass the collection's UID (`userId`-`collectionId`) value.

params.name: elementType
params.description: The element type.

items.docs:
Removes an element or delete a folder from your [Private API Network](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/adding-private-network/).

**Note:**

Removing an API, collection, or workspace element does not delete it. It only removes it from the Private API Network folder.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Respond to an element add request

params.name: requestId
params.description: The element request's ID.

items.docs: Responds to a request to add an element to the [Private API Network](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collaborating-in-postman/adding-private-network/). Only managers can approve or deny a request. Once approved, the element will appear in the team's Private API Network.
